vector_memory.semantic_summary: KnowledgeGraphManager serves as the central orchestration layer for managing the entire codebase knowledge graph lifecycle. It coordinates initial knowledge extraction from source files, which involves LLM calls to generate nodes and triples. The system then iteratively refines uncertain extractions through a multi-phase pipeline, using the graph database context to resolve ambiguities before persisting the validated knowledge.
